You can first use this tool to inspect the range and standard deviation, then use the median or a trimmed mean to represent the main grade, and treat rich mineral clusters separately as internal grade variation within the orebody.

map.：例：6 个刻槽样品的 Cu 品位（%）1.2, 1.5, 0.9, 2.1,: : Example: the Cu grade (%) of 6 channel samples 1.2, 1.5, 0.9, 2.1, 1.8, 1.3 gives n=6, mean=1.47%, median=1.40%, standard deviation σ=0.39%, range=1.20% (0.9%~2.1%). The fluctuation around the mean is mild, but there is a local high value of 2.1% that should be verified separately as a possible rich cluster.

It suits a quick grasp of the concentration and dispersion of orebody grades (with at least 5 samples in general).
